notes: Identity verified from supplied text: title Mechanisms of Selective Attention in Generalized Anxiety Disorder; Jenny Yiend, Andrew Mathews, Tom Burns, Kevin Dutton, Andrés Fernández-Martín, George A. Georgiou, Michael Luckie, Alexandra Rose, Riccardo Russo, Elaine Fox; DOI 10.1177/2167702614545216. This is a primary Europe PMC author manuscript with methods, results, references, figures and tables, not a secondary account or abstract. Header gives final publication 2015 September 1; 3(5):758–771, whereas input reference gives 2014. No supplied PDF exists for rendering. Both rows provide only p. 6, no experiment or contrast identifier; row 290 adds only a broad paper-level description. Manuscript Page 6 is methods, not statistical results. Final journal pagination cannot be mapped securely from that locator. Experiment 1 attentional results (manuscript pp. 7–8) contain multiple possible targets: Group × Valence interaction F(4,78)=3.56, p < .01, partial eta-squared .16; GAD Valence effect F(2,26)=5.68, p < .01, partial eta-squared .31; GAD angry versus neutral F(1,13)=9.35, p < .01, partial eta-squared .42; GAD angry versus happy F(1,13)=4.03, p < .07, partial eta-squared .24; happy versus neutral F(1,13)=1.65, partial eta-squared .11, no p printed for that contrast; control Valence F(2,26)=1.49, partial eta-squared .10, p=.24; high trait anxiety Valence F(2,26)=1.72, partial eta-squared .12, p=.20. Experiment 2 has additional candidate tests (pp. 11–12), including patient-only Validity × Facial Expression F(3,60)=2.98, p=.04, partial eta-squared .13. These are candidates only, not assigned by numeric or row-order correspondence. Candidate sample scopes only: Experiment 1 explicitly has three separate final participant groups, 14 GAD + 14 controls + 14 high trait anxiety = 42 participants for its full 3 × 3 model; GAD-only contrasts use the 14-patient group. Trial exclusions are errors and outliers, 3.5% of trials (2.4% errors + 1.1% outliers), not participant exclusions. Experiment 2 final groups are 21 GAD + 21 controls = 42 participants for full models, or 21 for patient-only model; four ineligible controls were replaced before analysis (p.10). Neither candidate sum is assigned to n_o because the target test/experiment remains unresolved. Requested Cohen's f^2 (2109) is not printed in these attentional results; printed η2p is partial eta-squared, not unqualified eta-squared. No metric conversions performed. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only; no replication source was read.
